lines.text: Did you know this is the furthest you can possibly get from the ocean,
so this spot in western China near the Kazakhstan border is called the Eurasian Po of inaccessibility and it sits over 2600 kilometers from the nearest sea.
That's further than London to Moscow, and you still wouldn't reach a beach.
However, geographers realized this spot might be wrong.
The original calculation ignored the Gulf of O and Russia,
which is basically a giant arm of the Arctic Ocean In 2007, researchers counted it as ocean,
and the pole jumped to two completely new spots,
both still in China and about 120 kilometers closer to the sea than everyone thought.
Here's the crazy part you've probably heard of point Nemo, the spot in the ocean furthest from any land.
which means the furthest you can get from the ocean and the furthest you can get from land are almost exactly the same distance under the old calculation,
So whether you're stranded in the desert or in the middle of the Pacific, the planet basically caps out at the same level of lonely.
